determinism.method: A two-run comparison of the DRAW is NOT AVAILABLE AND WAS NOT FAKED. The order permits exactly one metered reference_data draw and a second only on a failure of steps 1-3, which did not occur; repeating it purely to satisfy a determinism control would be an unauthorised metered request. It would also not be a same-input run, because PX_LAST is a moving quantity and a second call returning a different number would say nothing about instrument stability. What is reported instead is the internal consistency of the three reads inside a 75-second window, which is corroboration and is named as such rather than counted as a determinism pass.
